name: Nettle Root
summary: Nettle Root carries a Grade C rating — limited evidence. Strongest recorded design is a narrative review, drawn from 3 recorded studies, none of which measured an outcome in people. Recorded activity centres on inflammatory signaling modulation, hormonal signaling context and oxidative stress, which describes mechanism rather than demonstrated benefit. Noted cautions include pregnancy.
description: Nettle Root botanical profile with evidence, safety, and practical fit.
contraindications: pregnancy because nettle root may stimulate uterine contractions and raise miscarriage risk
diuretic or blood pressure medication because nettle root may have additive fluid-loss and blood-pressure-lowering effects
lithium because nettle root diuretic effect can reduce lithium clearance and raise lithium levels
diabetes or anticoagulant medication because nettle root may have additive blood-glucose-lowering or blood-thinning effects
